name: typed-contract-tab
goal: Give every entity a dedicated, revision-scoped Contract tab with types, descriptions and honest examples.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Move Contract out of Overview. Its own tab shows typed inputs, outputs, errors and examples; retain Details and Source compatibility.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing checks require inline contracts and omit data types and examples. Extend standardized contract, routing, manifest round-trip and responsive browser checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Latest sealed red a1faf142 at 24e1b1ee fails the missing-tab assertion. Fixtures cover branch tips and selected commits; earlier checkpoints remain.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus implemented the typed Contract tab; focused component checks pass. Optional examples preserve false, zero, null and escaped markup.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed green 26638186 at 129aa917 passes the same command and 1,257 frozen inputs as red a1faf142 at 24e1b1ee.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Web build, unit suites, responsive navigation and all required captures pass. Full check is blocked by three existing file-size findings; Electron checks remain paused.
